Callout.Name: Refuse Fire
Callout.Message: Bins on fire behind a row of shops.
Callout.Advisory: Two bins alight, no structures involved.

Script.Line: The bins went up behind the row of shops.
There is a takeaway extractor on that wall and it is full of grease.
It has been going twenty minutes and nobody has come out.

Lines.Approach: Two bins behind the shops. Get there before it reaches the fence.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
